features.title: M0 Foundation — Scaffold, tokens, theme engine, shell, routes, mock repo, seed generator, rules and metrics with unit tests, dev menu
acceptance: Given the application loads, When rendered in light or dark mode, Then design tokens from tokens.css apply without unstyled flash
Given the domain rules and metrics, When tested with Vitest, Then 100% of line transitions, task derivations, visit readiness, and KPI formulas pass unit tests
Given the mock repository and seed generator, When reset, Then deterministic sample data with Ana (Owner) and Ben (Helper) is generated
Given the router, When any route defined in section 10.2 is visited, Then the page renders cleanly inside the responsive shell
Given the dev menu, When toggling persona, offline mode, or failure rate, Then the application state updates accordingly
features.evidence: Vitest 18/18 tests passed in 1.84s (rules and metrics); TypeScript check passed (0 errors); Production bundle built in 4.34s; Localhost dev server running at http://localhost:5173/ and verified via browser subagent.
